claim: A list circulating in October 2026 names people connected to Jeffrey Epstein who have died. These entries cover 2022 and 2023. Official rulings are attributed to whoever made them, and where the list's dates or links differ from the record, the record is given. (1) Jean-Luc Brunel, a French modeling agent whose agency MC2 Epstein helped fund, was found hanged in his cell at La Santé prison in Paris on February 19, 2022. He was awaiting trial on charges of raping minors. A French judicial inquiry concluded in March 2023 that he died by suicide. (2) Val Broeksmit, whose stepfather William Broeksmit, a former senior Deutsche Bank risk executive, hanged himself in London in January 2014, later gave the bank's internal documents to journalists and federal investigators. Val was found dead on the grounds of Wilson High School in Los Angeles on April 25, 2022, at 46. His cause of death has been reported as an accidental fall from a tree and, elsewhere, as undetermined. FBI photographs from the August 2022 Mar-a-Lago search show a 2019 New York Times feature about him, not a report of his death, in a box of documents marked confidential. Neither Broeksmit appears in the DOJ Epstein release. (3) Mark Middleton, a special assistant to President Clinton, died on May 7, 2022, not in February, at a ranch in Perry County, Arkansas. He was found with a shotgun wound and an electrical cord around his neck tied to a tree. Authorities ruled it suicide, and his family obtained a court order sealing the scene photographs. White House visitor logs, reported in 2019, show Epstein visiting at least 17 times between 1993 and 1995, several of them to meet Middleton. Emails in the release show a Mark Middleton phoning Epstein's office in July 2009. In July 2013 a Mark Middleton of Middleton Inc. thanked Epstein's assistant for a photograph and asked for Epstein's contact details, which Epstein approved. (4) Steven Hoffenberg, former head of Towers Financial, the collapsed Ponzi scheme where Epstein worked in the late 1980s, was found dead in his Derby, Connecticut apartment in August 2022 at 77. He had been dead about a week. The autopsy found no trauma, and the cause was left pending toxicology. (5) Kenneth Starr, who joined Epstein's defense team in 2007 during the negotiations that produced his 2008 plea deal, died on September 13, 2022, at 76 from complications of surgery. (6) Carolyn Andriano, who testified against Ghislaine Maxwell at her 2021 trial, was found unresponsive in a West Palm Beach hotel room on May 23, 2023, at 36. Police said she died of an accidental overdose, and her mother disputed the finding. (7) Bill Richardson, former New Mexico governor and UN ambassador, died at his Chatham, Massachusetts summer home on September 1, 2023, at 75. Epstein's Zorro Ranch is in New Mexico. Virginia Giuffre named Richardson in a deposition unsealed in 2019; he denied it and said he had never met her.

notes: Part 2 of 3 of a circulating Epstein death list (part 1: 2026-epstein-death-list-001, 2014–2020; part 3: 2026-epstein-death-list-003, 2025–2026). Corpus-first: Brunel 4.5k hits; Broeksmit 0 hits (neither William nor Val); Middleton 26 hits (Groff/Epstein emails 2009 + 2013; the 2013 sender signs 'Middleton Inc' with a 501 [central Arkansas] cell — number not reproduced; identity with the Clinton aide is consistent but not stated as proven, hence 'a Mark Middleton'; also a compiled bio in the release, EFTA00263405, stating Epstein 'met with President Clinton's aide Mark Middleton on at least three occasions at the White House'); Hoffenberg 341; Starr 747; Andriano 23 (victim/plaintiff material in the release — NOT quoted; only her public trial testimony and reported death are used); Richardson 1.3k. The list said Val Broeksmit was William's 'son' (stepson per Wikipedia/NYT), that the Mar-a-Lago item was an NYT 'article announcing his death' (it was Enrich's 2019 feature, per Newsweek/Enrich), and dated Middleton to Feb 2022 (May 7). Val's cause: Wikipedia cites coroner 'accidental ... blunt force trauma' / fall from a tree; Newsweek says ME 'undetermined' — both given. Rulings attributed, not adopted. Hoffenberg final cause not located; left as pending. Richardson cause not stated in sources fetched (left out). Source capture: DekgiOlS1xd.
